display.purpose: Step and Finish stage headings only.

shadows.name: selected-ring
shadows.purpose: Selected object. A hairline, not lift.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 9px 17px; border: 1px solid #e8a266; border-radius: 10px; background: #e8a266; color: #1a1209; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 580; transition: transform 140ms ease, background 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f0b27c; border-color: #f0b27c; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8a266; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 40px; padding: 9px 17px; border: 1px solid #3a3a40; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #f1efe9; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 580; transition: transform 140ms ease, background 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #5a5a62; background: #17171a; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8a266; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: A low-priority action, such as Pause.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #a3a1a6; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 580; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: #17171a; color: #f1efe9; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8a266; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: A dim, warm working room for long sessions. The picture is the lit object on the bench, the tools stay quiet around it, and amber marks what is active, like a safelight.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black, slightly warm tonal layers instead of shadows.
One accent: amber, on the primary action, the selection and the focus.
Serif for headings that name where you are, system sans for controls, mono for time.

rules.name: The Blue and Orange Rule
rules.body: A drawn box is blue and a found box is orange, everywhere boxes appear.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: The serif is for headings that name where you are.

rules.name: The No Lift Rule
rules.body: Do not float a surface with a soft drop shadow.

dos: Do keep the video the brightest thing on screen.
Do keep Edit one fixed screen, with scrolling inside its panels.
donts: Don't add a second accent colour.
Don't add web fonts or remote assets.
